New York: Tiffany is opening a 10,000-piece Jean Schlumberger archive for conservation.

The Fifth Avenue house began a four-year project with Paris's Musée des Arts Décoratifs to conserve and digitize 5,000 drawings and documents. Tiffany marked the start with "I Am Only a Pencil," an exhibition of Schlumberger's drawings at Paris Fashion Week.
